controls.krw_pos: KRW-BTC minutes/60 count=200 with `to` = 2026-09-01T00:00Z (Upbit '...Z', Bithumb naive KST '2026-09-01T09:00:00') must return 200 rows, newest bar open 2026-08-31T23:00:00; body sha256 must equal the first run's (reference stored in plan/control_reference_<venue>.json)
controls.krw_neg_to: Upbit: `to`=2016-01-01T00:00:00Z (before venue launch) must return HTTP 200 + []; Bithumb: `to`='2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' (Z spelling) must return HTTP 200 + a non-list body containing 'Invalid parameter' (CORRECTION_1: not an empty list)
controls.krw_neg_code: market KRW-ZZZNOTACOIN must return a non-list body containing 'Code not found' (Upbit HTTP 404, Bithumb HTTP 200)
controls.binance_neg: futures/um monthly indexPriceKlines ZZZNOTACOINUSDT 2026-07 must return HTTP 404
controls.on_failure: worker writes run/ABORT_<venue>_<run>.json and exits 2 before any data request

stop_rules.page_accept: HTTP 200 AND JSON list AND bar opens strictly descending AND newest open < cursor AND opens aligned (60m: hour; day: Upbit 00:00Z, Bithumb 15:00Z) AND market field == requested market
stop_rules.cursor: first request `to` = PULL_END; next `to` = oldest bar open of the last accepted page (exclusive); resume = min oldest open over accepted manifest pages
stop_rules.done_cutoff: oldest open < CUTOFF (60m) or < CUTOFF - 1 day (days)
stop_rules.done_first_trade: page shorter than 200 AND oldest open < census first day label + 1 day
stop_rules.empty_list: accepted as DONE only when cursor <= census first day label + 1 day or <= the unit cutoff; otherwise EMPTY_UNEXPECTED (retried once after 5 s, then error; market left not done)
stop_rules.short_page_early: page shorter than 200 with oldest open >= census first day + 1 day => SHORT_PAGE_BEFORE_FIRST_DAY error (truncation suspect), market left not done
stop_rules.errors: non-200 status or non-list body (incl. Bithumb HTTP 200 + error body) => errors_<venue>.jsonl, market left not done, retried in pass 2; never written as a page
stop_rules.binance: HTTP 200 + valid zip (one CSV member) => stored; HTTP 404 => NOT_FOUND record (a fact); other status or bad zip => error, retried in pass 2

checks.C0_integrity: every manifest page file exists, gunzipped body sha256 == manifest body_sha256, row count == manifest n; orphan page files counted
checks.C1_earliest_bar: 60m: if census first day >= CUTOFF, earliest bar open in [first day label, +1 day); else earliest bar open < CUTOFF. days: earliest day open <= max(first day label, CUTOFF - 1 day)
checks.C2_seams: pages ordered by cursor descending: page(k+1).to == page(k).oldest_open and page(k+1).newest_open < page(k).oldest_open; 0 duplicate bar opens
checks.C3_volume_identity: for every venue day [d0, d0+24h) with d0 >= max(first day label, CUTOFF) and d0+24h <= PULL_END: sum of 60m candle_acc_trade_volume == day candle_acc_trade_volume; rel diff <= 1e-9 EXACT, <= 1e-6 ROUNDING, else MISMATCH (also a day bar with no hourly bars or hourly bars with no day bar is MISMATCH)
checks.C4_freshness: newest 60m bar open == PULL_END - 1h => FRESH; else if any complete venue day after the newest hourly bar has day volume > 0 => STALE_MISSING (fail), else THIN_OK
checks.C5_http: per host: attempts by status, unresolved errors, accepted empty lists with reasons, 429 count, max requests in any rolling 1 s window from send log (must be <= 5)
checks.C6_binance: per zip: header present, ms open_time, contiguous hours, close_time == open + 3599999, rows == hours in month unless first/last listing month; NOT_FOUND months inside [elig_first, elig_last] => FLAG_MISSING_INDEX

identity_guard.series: per pair and hour t with KRW bar, KRW-BTC bar (same venue), Binance index bar and BTCUSDT index bar: r(t) = ln(Pkrw_i/Pkrw_BTC) - ln((Pidx_i/mult)/Pidx_BTC)
identity_guard.daily: d(day) = median r over the UTC day's hours (days with >= 6 hours)
identity_guard.rolling: m30(day) = median of d over the trailing 30 UTC days (>= 10 days present); m7 likewise over 7 days (>= 3 present)
identity_guard.policy: flag only; nothing is dropped; per pair report n hours checked, checked range, flagged ranges and the extreme |m30| inside flagged ranges only

offset_spectrum.targets: per venue, per calendar year in the pull (2021 = December only): KRW-BTC vs BTCUSDT index and KRW-XRP vs XRPUSDT index
offset_spectrum.method: hourly ln close; detrend x~(t) = x(t) - mean over |s - t| <= 24 h (>= 24 finite); rho(k) = Pearson corr(x~(t+k), y~(t)), k = -12..+12; dispersion D(k) = std of [x(t+k) - y(t)] minus its centred 49 h median
offset_spectrum.PASS: argmax rho == 0 AND rho(0) > max(rho(-1), rho(+1)) AND argmin D == 0
offset_spectrum.negative_controls: KST-as-UTC relabel (x(t-9h)) must give argmax +9 and argmin +9; close-time relabel (x(t-1h)) must give +1 and +1
